"Faria":
"...Neon City.
It is one of the sectors of the Nameless City that was functional until about 500 years ago."
"I've heard that many of the people who lived here, the former Resurgent ARKS, fell victim to internal conflicts and dangerous experiments."

"Because the people were gone, there was no longer a need to maintain the sector,
and the facilities were entirely sealed off. Zephetto said it would never be restored."
"For some reason, we received reports that the lights came on, as you can see. The cause is currently unknown."
"There are remnants of entertainment facilities nearby, but it seems that dangerous enemies are also lurking around. Please proceed with caution while investigating."
